teaser: A notebook fills with half-finished poems, each one abandoned near the ending. You are life path 11 and an INFP, and this crossing makes the reach for meaning almost involuntary — the kind of pull that starts a thing in a rush of feeling and then second-guesses it all the way to completion. The 11 asks for a kind of radiance that lands somewhere outside the self; the INFP asks that nothing be said unless it is true to the self first. What is particular here is how often those two requests arrive in the same breath, so that the clearest-feeling idea of the week also comes wrapped in doubt about whether it was ever really yours to say.
